name: MoYu HuaMeng TG 3x3 V2 (Magnetic, Ball-Core)
description: The MoYu HuaMeng TG 3x3 V2 (Magnetic, Ball-Core) is the 8-Magnet Ball-Core build of HuaMeng's gear-driven flagship 3x3 — a magnetic speed cube designed to make tuning audible, repeatable, and precise. Each gear click moves a magnet by 0.1mm, so dialing in a feel stops being guesswork.
features: Elasticity, 9 levels: Quantified core elasticity lets you tune rebound speed and strength on a clear scale.
Tension, 6 levels: Defined tension steps replace half-turns and feel; pick a number, lock it in, repeat it.
Cube Torch tool included: One double-ended tool — handle adjusts magnets, head adjusts elasticity.
Core Positioning 1.0 architecture: 8 Ball-Core magnets plus 8 corner foot magnets focus on stable, reliable acceleration.
Integrated friction surface: Reinforced internal contact surfaces resist cracking and separation under speed-solve stress.
Internal anti-twist feet: Seamless interlocking pieces help prevent pops at high speed.
